key_insight: CoBe shows that models often rewrite scenarios associatively instead of preserving unchanged facts when asked to make counterfactual edits.
clinical_relevance: In healthcare-facing AI, preserving causal medical details while changing only the hypothetical outcome is essential for reliable, safety-sensitive communication.
method: Built CoBe, a benchmark of 2,000 conversational counterfactual editing questions.
Covers healthcare, science and engineering, business, and everyday scenarios.
Evaluates zero-shot model behavior on whether edits keep causal structure intact.
evidence_signal: Frontier models averaged 58.05% on the benchmark, and performance did not scale consistently with model size or output length.
watch_item: A key implementation concern is that fluent outputs may still be wrong if the model changes unaffected facts, so human review is needed for high-stakes use.
paper_title: CoBe: A Benchmark For Conversational Counterfactual Text Editing
